online.inline: Or put the booking on a page of its own
online.addService: Add {service} to a button to open on that service, or {button} to the script for a button in the corner of every page. Works with Wix, Squarespace, WordPress and hand-built sites.
online.pageFrom: Services, prices, the team, opening hours and your phone number come from the rest of Settings, so your page never disagrees with the diary.
online.headline: Headline
online.headlineExample: Nails you'll love, at a time that suits you.
online.aboutExample: A sentence or two about you.
online.rulesHow: Online bookings follow the same rules as the phone: your hours, who works when, blocked time, at least two hours' notice, and 48 hours for a new client's patch test.

online.chooseStylist: Let clients choose their nail technician
online.chooseStylistHint: Otherwise they are booked with whoever is free, as by phone.
online.servicesHint: Untick anything that needs a chat first, like a consultation or custom nail art. New services are bookable online until you untick them.
